page.layout: Running head at top, centred: "Deque Vrbe Groninga." Page number at top right. One block of running text in one column, with a marginal note at the right, beside the last lines. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: fossâ in morem reliquarum urbium cin-cta fuit, angustiore etiam tum, quàm jam est, ambitu. Nunc ab eo fere tem-pore, quo tormentorum æneorum usus percrebuit, maximè verò à Caroli bel-latoris Ducis Burgundiæ ævo, cùm is ar-ma Frisiæ minaretur, vallo terreo cum fossâ patentiore ampliatis terminis est cir-cumdata: cujus valli ambitus est, in summâ superficie, passuum IIM. LXXXVI, & in eo molæ, quæ ventis agitantur, XII; duæque præter has extra mœnia in latere septentrionali. Hac amplificatione mœ-nium postrema versus ortum, meridi-em, occasum accessio urbi facta; solum latus boreum, abAhâ amne urbem egre-diente, portaque vicina cum parte late-ris ortivi ad portam usque Polanam, loco motum non est: atque ita Botterana quoque porta, & Ebbingana, & Polana sedem suam retinuêre; reliquæ, maximè Dominica, Orientalis, Steentullana, sunt promotæ. Ex portis his Polana pyrami-Rursum de portis dibus excelsis ac magnæ molis duabus, O-rientalis etiam quatuor sed gracilioribus, Dominica quinque similibus magnifica speciè

page.notes: The marginal note "Rursum / de portis" is two lines in italic, set beside the lines "promotæ... pyrami-" and "dibus excelsis"; it is placed here at the point where it stands. Doubtful readings: the Roman numeral in "passuum IIM. LXXXVI" and "XII" are printed with spaced and small-cap style "1 1M." and "X I I"; transcribed as printed in normal numerals. "abAhâ" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. The final word "specie" is the catchword at the lower right, not part of the running text.
